items.difficulty_reason: Existence/uniqueness lemma (statement 5587-5600, proof 5602-5627): glues the objects E_U along the simplicial semi-representable object via formal products and the maps rho_a - the simplicial-system condition follows immediately from the assumed composition relations, existence from the chapter's cartesian-derived-from-simplicial lemma under the negative-ext vanishing, and uniqueness from the nullity and Hom lemmas; no verification is omitted. H2: glueing assembled from established derived-category lemmas.
